$comment: React Compiler rule waivers (V2-06 06-08, R-30). Each entry downgrades one react-hooks rule to warn for one file. `sites` is the exact finding count at error (a ratchet), `expires` at most 90 days after `added`; tests/ci/react-compiler-waivers.spec.ts fails on an expired, stale (no longer matching), miscounted or over-90-day entry, and eslint.config.mjs stops applying an expired entry. Renew only with a new reason and owner; prefer fixing.

waivers.reason: Prop-to-state sync of the saved diagnoses and a debounced ICD search with synchronous clearing. V2-09b rebuilds the consult workspace and its save model (the sync is part of that model).
Suggestion fetch clears synchronously for a short diagnosis; the Smart Assist suggestions are rebuilt with the consult workspace in V2-09b.
Prop-to-state sync of Rx items and a debounced CDCI drug search with synchronous clearing; V2-09c rebuilds the Rx builder on RxEntryRow/RxLineItem (06-03b).

Billing load on open and the amount-to-pay follow of the draft total. V2-10 rebuilds checkout with the billing invariants (collect, cancel/void/refund) and lib/money; changing when the amount field follows the total in the v1 drawer is a billing behaviour change outside V2-06.
Fetch-on-mount sets its loading flag synchronously; V2-11 rebuilds the patient profile and relabels labs as documents (P1-24), loading them on the server.
Fetch-on-mount of the in-app notification list sets its loading flag synchronously; the v1 notification hook is replaced when V2-11 deletes the v1 components (server-loaded list).
